components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action: cobalt fill, 10px radius, 32px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:10px;background:#1d4ed8;color:#fff;font:500 14px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s,transform .2s}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:rgb(29 78 216 / .8)}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(49 100 211 / .5)}

components.name: Sky Call-to-action
components.description: The one action in the sky hero: periwinkle fill on the dark room, arrow nudges down on hover.
components.html: Browse albums
components.css: .ds-sky{padding:24px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0f1a31,#080d19);border-radius:14px}.ds-sky-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px;padding:0 18px 0 20px;border-radius:10px;background:#8fb0ff;color:#0b1424;font:650 15px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .25s,transform .25s}.ds-sky-cta svg{transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-sky-cta:hover{background:#aac2ff}.ds-sky-cta:hover svg{transform:translateY(3px)}.ds-sky-cta:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-sky-cta:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #8fb0ff;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Density Control
components.description: S / M / L thumbnail size toggle; the pressed button takes the secondary fill.
components.css: .ds-density{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;padding:2px;border:1px solid #dce4f1;border-radius:8px}.ds-density button{min-width:36px;min-height:36px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:#526174;font:600 13px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s,color .2s}.ds-density button:hover{background:#edf2fb}.ds-density button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#eff4ff;color:#1f3b75}.ds-density button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3164d3;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Album Card
components.description: A ringed card with a fanned stack of the album's pictures; no shadow on the card itself.
components.html:
Hero avatars

Avatar portraits for the hero section.

720 images
components.css: .ds-card{overflow:hidden;width:280px;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;color:#202938;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgb(32 41 56 / .1);font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}.ds-card-art{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:#edf2fb}.ds-sheet{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:50%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8fb0ff,#3164d3);box-shadow:0 12px 28px -8px rgb(5 8 14 / .5);translate:-50% -50%}.ds-sheet.s2{transform:translate(-4%,-6%) rotate(-3deg) scale(.9);opacity:.7}.ds-sheet.s1{transform:translate(4%,-3%) rotate(2.5deg) scale(.95);opacity:.85}.ds-card-body{padding:16px}.ds-card h3{margin:0;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.01em}.ds-card p{margin:4px 0 8px;color:#526174;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}.ds-count{font:12px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, Consolas, monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#526174}

components.name: Thumbnail
components.description: A picture at its own aspect ratio; the mono key rises on a scrim on hover and focus.
components.css: .ds-thumb{position:relative;display:block;width:152px;aspect-ratio:1;overflow:hidden;border-radius:8px;background:#edf2fb;color:#f4f7fb;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-thumb-img{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8fb0ff,#1d4ed8);transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-key{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;left:0;padding:28px 8px 6px;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgb(5 8 14 / .78),transparent);font:11px/1.25 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, Consolas, monospace;opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s}.ds-thumb:hover,.ds-thumb:focus-visible{transform:scale(1.04);box-shadow:0 20px 36px -14px rgb(5 8 14 / .6)}.ds-thumb:hover .ds-thumb-img{transform:scale(1.07)}.ds-thumb:hover .ds-key,.ds-thumb:focus-visible .ds-key{opacity:1;transform:none}.ds-thumb:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3164d3;outline-offset:3px}

components.description: Round 44px control in the dark viewer; hover lifts a white veil, press scales down.

narrative.overview:
A picture is judged in a dark room, so the gallery builds one. The page around it is a pale or deep blue-grey sheet that stays quiet on purpose: one blue, a system font, ringed surfaces, no shadow on any piece of chrome. Pictures supply the colour. Inside that page sit two dark rooms that do not change with the visitor's theme: the sky hero on the home page and the viewer that opens over an album. They carry their own palette because the thing in front of the visitor is a picture, and a picture reads best against near-black.

Density is open. The wall of albums and the grid of thumbnails fill the width up to 120rem, with the gutter doing the framing. Motion is authored once per surface (the wall rising on home, the thumbnail travelling into the viewer) and everything else is a short transition. Nothing is added that the data does not carry: a key, a size, a prompt, a seed.
keyCharacteristics: One blue for links, actions and focus; the pictures carry all other colour.
Chrome separates with rings and borders; a shadow means a picture has been lifted.
Two fixed dark rooms (sky, viewer) inside a theme-following page.
Native system font and a native monospace for keys, counts and readouts; no web font.
Motion is one authored moment per surface; hover effects belong to a fine pointer; reduced motion removes all of it.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Links, actions and focus use the single blue (Cobalt Link in light, Periwinkle Glow in dark). A second accent hue is not introduced; colour variety comes from the images.

rules.name: The Fixed Dark Rule
rules.body: The sky and the viewer stay dark in a light theme. They own a palette; page tokens do not leak into them and theirs do not leak out.

rules.name: The Picture Tint Rule
rules.body: Where a surface needs colour, borrow it from the album's own cover (the blurred wash behind a card, the glow under an album page, the ambient light behind the viewer picture) instead of picking a decorative hue.

rules.name: The Data Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a value from the pipeline (a key, a seed, a size, a range) is set in the monospace stack with tabular numerals. Descriptive text is never mono.

rules.name: The One H1 Rule
rules.body: Each page has exactly one `h1`; the site name in the top bar is a link, not a heading.

rules.name: The Real Shape Rule
rules.body: A cell, a stack or a cover takes the aspect ratio the index reports for its image. Pictures are never cropped to a house ratio.

rules.name: The Lifted Picture Rule
rules.body: A shadow means a picture is in the air. A card, a button, a bar or a panel never gets one.

dos: **Do** let the pictures carry colour; keep the chrome to the one blue, the neutrals and the dark rooms.
**Do** keep the sky and the viewer dark in every theme.
**Do** use a shadow only on a lifted picture, always with an offset and a blur.
**Do** write scroll-driven animation as longhands (`animation-name`, `animation-timeline`), because the minifier folds a complete shorthand into one declaration that some browsers drop.
**Do** put hover effects behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` and make every animation resolve to the plain visible state, so a page without script or with reduced motion shows everything.
**Do** use the monospace stack with tabular numerals for data values; keep 44px targets on links and viewer controls.
donts: **Don't** put cards around thumbnails; keys sit on a scrim over the picture.
**Don't** add a second accent hue, a web font or a theme toggle.
**Don't** give a card, button, bar or panel a box shadow.
**Don't** crop pictures to a fixed ratio; use the ratio the index reports.
**Don't** hide content behind an animation's start state: keyframes have no `to`, so the resting state is the real card.
